title: PM Modi Extends Invitation to BRICS Summit Amid Hormuz Talks
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, discussing the importance of freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz. The conversation took place as India prepares to host the BRICS summit. The PM's comments on Hormuz come amid tensions between Iran and its neighbors. This event highlights India's role in regional diplomacy and its stance on global maritime security.
summary_points: PM Modi spoke with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian about freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz
The conversation took place as India prepares to host the BRICS summit
India's comments on Hormuz come amid tensions between Iran and its neighbors
This event highlights India's role in regional diplomacy
It also underscores India's stance on global maritime security
